platform_label: AMD Ryzen 9 8945H w/ Radeon 780M Graphics, 16 logical CPUs, Windows
caveats: Different tools evaluate different models: RISReflector is far-field plane-wave with isotropic unit cells and no cell-area factor; only sremu and the MATLAB hand-loop, vectorized and toolbox K1 paths compute the same near-field K1 sum.
MATLAB times exclude MATLAB start-up (timeit inside one session); sremu times exclude numba compilation and include Python dispatch.
Literature numbers are REPORTED with their own hardware; not a speed comparison.

background_load.note: background_busy = system busy fraction minus this process's CPU share; child processes (MATLAB, ZMQ clients, controller processes, parallel point workers) count as background
